slots.instagram_caption:
枕頭芯先分記憶棉、羽絨還是纖維，再看能不能水洗。

我會先捏枕頭芯、翻開外層布看填充。記憶棉按下去回彈慢、不能丟洗衣機；羽絨看鑽毛和結塊；纖維芯可以洗，熱水一煮會扁。自己把枕頭芯泡水再脫水，記憶棉會裂、羽絨結成團。

如果填充已經結塊或發霉，洗完也只能改善、回不到新的蓬鬆。台中市區我們免費到府收送，你先拍整顆和近照給我們看。

slots.image_prompt: OBJECT PASSPORT: exactly one bare pillow insert with its inner ticking visible (object locked as one bare pillow insert with its inner ticking visible; every surface is blank: no printed, embossed, woven or stitched marks, letters, labels or emblems of any size); color/material: used pillow insert with inner ticking and mixed fill; wear marks: compressed fill and a greyed contact patch on the ticking. WEAR FIRST (this is the story of the photo): everyday wear as grey dust in the texture valleys, greyed contact points and small scuffs with crisp edges, clearly visible against the cleaner areas, at the positions named by the topic (compressed fill and a greyed contact patch on the ticking); it covers roughly 25-40% of that area and is strong enough to read at thumbnail size from arm's length, on the side that faces the camera; the rest of the object is clean enough that the marked area is unmistakably the problem, but the object is a used everyday item, not new stock. MATERIAL OPTICS: the fabric shows its real weave or knit texture at close range, matte with a faint sheen only along fold ridges; worn or soiled areas read as clearly darker regions that follow the contact line, with a visible edge, never as painted patches. SCENE LOCK: the same shoe-washing sink station with the wet stainless drainboard on every slide; do not change location, backdrop, or room across slides. Create one portrait 4:5 photo. Keep the exact featured object consistent across all four photos. LOCATION: the shoe-washing station: a stainless drainboard beside a deep sink, still damp with small water beads, two brushes and a bar of saddle soap at the frame edge, a green rubber mat on the floor beyond, fluorescent tube light overhead and a small window to one side; no pink mat. COMPOSITION (hero, crop allowed): frame the half of the object that carries the problem, the object cut by the frame edge on one side and set off-centre with its mass near x=40% or x=60%, filling 60-75% of the frame height; one adult hand entering from the frame edge, wrist only, fingers holding or pressing right beside the problem area with five clearly separated fingers; a handheld lint roller rests at the frame edge as a foreground occlusion; the surface fills the bottom of the frame, not empty space. LIGHTING: one clear key light from a window on one side: the lit side of the object is bright and the far side falls to mid-grey with a visible shadow edge running across the object; a dense contact shadow at the base that softens outward; ceiling fluorescent fills only enough to keep shadow detail; the counter or mat must not tint the whites. STYLE: candid documentary phone photo taken by the shop worker mid-inspection, the action caught while it happens, slight handheld tilt and framing imperfection; not editorial, not catalogue, not studio. CAMERA: phone main camera, 26mm-equivalent, held from the worker's standing eye line looking down about 25 degrees, f/1.8 look: the problem area sharp, the far side of the object slightly softer, the background clearly out of focus. COLOR: neutral daylight indoor tone with honest contrast, low saturation close to documentary colour, whites read white where clean and grey where soiled; no pink or warm cast on the object. Photo 1 of 4. Hero still of 枕頭芯先分記憶棉、羽絨還是纖維，再看能不能水洗 through the passport item as the main close-up on the locked inspection counter. Keep the object recognizable even when cropped and do not imply a cleaning result. Avoid: readable label text, a second duvet, a bedroom set, a waxy plastic-coated surface, a second hand.
